notes.title: Release time adjustment notice
notes.notes:
Dear Steam players,

The game Local Mom is a Slut, originally scheduled for release in Q2, is still undergoing final adjustments and translation work. To provide a more polished gameplay experience, we have decided to postpone the release to Q3 2025.

Thank you for your support and patience. We will do our utmost to deliver the best possible game as soon as we can!
